TestCqlTracing::test_tracing_simple.description: 3-node cluster (3 racks), RF=3. Creates ks.users, then via cqlsh with TRACING ON runs SELECT, INSERT (CL=ALL) and SELECT by key (CL=ALL); asserts cqlsh prints 'Tracing session:' and 'Request complete', and that the final SELECT trace lists events from all 3 node IPs and returns the inserted row. Guards basic CQL tracing (session/events written to system_traces and fetched by cqlsh) including replica-side events from remote nodes.

TestCqlTracing::test_tracing_shutdown.description: 2-node cluster (2 racks), RF=2, trace probability 1.0 on both. Inserts 500 keys, flushes and stops node1; asserts no 'Assertion .* failed' in node1 log and that system_traces.sessions contains exactly 500 INSERT sessions (all traces flushed before shutdown). Then restarts node1, starts background inserts (1000/15000 keys), stops node2 mid-load after random <1s. Guards shutdown ordering: CQL server stopped before tracing, tracing RPC from remote node during shutdown, pending traces flushed.
